verdict.rationale: The H200 is hardware, but its official software ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM microservices) could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. No evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on developer.nvidia.com returning 404, and the llms.txt file that does exist is a docs index, not an API spec.
